identity.product_scope: Governed Select-family shared popup viewport geometry and its listbox overflow behavior.

root_cause: The shared hardening CSS forced max-height:min(420px,calc(100dvh - 40px))!important on every Quasar listbox and applied overflow:hidden!important. This overrode Quasar 3.15.0 QMenu position-engine inline max-height (86px in the repro), so a bottom-edge listbox kept a 134px box, overflowed by 9.578125px, covered the field, and clipped its internally scrollable options.
implementation: Removed the forced listbox max-height and generic hidden overflow from listboxes; retained hidden overflow on governed non-listbox menus and set listbox overflow-x:hidden / overflow-y:auto. Quasar QMenu now controls placement and available-height sizing. Select-family wrapper, CHG-108 focus repair, options mapping and route construction are unchanged.
